:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-ci}
#### Approximate confidence interval for the exponential mean

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle,
use the [observed information](#def-oinf) at the MLE from @exr-prac-exp-mle-oinf-at-mle to give an [approximate 95% confidence interval](inference.qmd#def-approximate-ci) for $\pmean$.

:::
